title: Nut Button
blurb: The big blue button gets slammed, and the image meme behind it is about urges surrendered to instantly. The format long ago generalised past its origin and now covers any temptation that never stood a chance — snoozing the alarm, buying the thing, eating the last slice while telling yourself you're saving it. What sells the audio is the decisiveness. No gentle press here, just a palm coming down hard. Resistance was never really on the table.
origin: From the blue 'nut button' image meme, generalized to any instantly-surrendered urge.
